title: `X-Forwarded-For` is the only client-address header read; a trusted peer sending another is warned about, and an untrusted header is ignored, never refused
divergesFromPhp: `X-Real-IP`, `CF-Connecting-IP`, `True-Client-IP`, `Fastly-Client-IP`, `X-Client-IP` and RFC 7239 `Forwarded` are never read, so the common `proxy_set_header X-Real-IP` recipe alone leaves every client as the proxy
